title: Hero flydubai Pilot Smit Machchhar Airlifted From Saudi Arabia To Abu Dhabi
summary_full: Indian pilot captain Smit Machchhar was stabbed by his co-pilot inside the cockpit aboard flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The co-pilot apparently wanted to crash the plane.
